name: error_1064_should_apply_to_callback_defi_9b4aa360
subject: fix(45901): Error 1064 should apply to @callback definitions in the same way as @param, but doesn't (#54625)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Fixes #45901: in JS files with an @callback type tag, the return-type checks (generator void, async Promise checks) now use the callback's return type node. This makes the expected error 1064 appear for @callback definitions as it does for @param.
